Name: Em's Ducks
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Twelve colour options for the ducks. Making them softer and more realistic-looking
It includes the duck, baby duck, feather, egg, mayo and Marnie's livestock shop icon
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

The different types are:
MallardMale (brown and green)
MallardFemale (brown)
Call (white)
Wood (brown with small tuft)
Pintail (long tail with blue bill)
Swedish (black with green bill)
Saxony (brown and white)
Muscovy (pink bill)
Apple (white brown speckled)
Mandarin (Greenblue and brown)
Bluebill (brown with blue bill)
Cayuga (black green)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Ducks CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When hatching a duck egg or buying a duck from Marnie, the type gets randomised and can be any of the twelve options
If you rather choose which colour you buy, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]

Alternatively, you can choose ﻿"Em's Ducks CP Config"
This allows you to choose one type for your farm with a [i]config.json[/i]

The default is the Mallard male. To choose a different type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Duck mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]MallardMale[/color]" with the name of the type you like
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/KvgdkHv6/Duck-Config.png[/img]

You can optionally choose to recolour the duck egg and mayonnaise
There are three egg colours, [color=#e69138]brown[/color], [color=#e69138]blue[/color] and [color=#e69138]black[/color]
All items can be disabled and individually changed
To do so, change "[color=#e69138]true[/color]" to "[color=#e69138]false[/color]" in the [i]config.json[/i]

Ducks and ducklings can swim when petted, fed and close to water
To prompt them to swim more regularly, try using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15860]Like A Duck To Water[/url]
